text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby. If we take to this once-in-a-lifetime stage, we might just be able to get closer to Manhattan Cafe's friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe still has hopes of entering the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, according to Agnes Tachyon's judgment, she's in no state to be attempting any intense races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon prepares a running test for Manhattan Cafe, who runs out of energy before she can finish it. Seeing this, I realize I need to consider our next steps very carefully.
